checks.text: Clicking the button "Add item" adds a new item with the text "New item" to the tree.
With one item "New item", clicking the button "Indent" on that item changes its indent level to 1.
With one item at indent level 1, clicking the button "Outdent" changes its indent level to 0.
With two items "A" and "B" at indent level 0, dragging item "A" below item "B" using the drag handle reorders the list so "B" appears before "A".
Clicking the button "Export Markdown" copies the text "- A\n- B" to the clipboard when the outline contains items "A" and "B" at indent level 0.
With an item "A" at indent level 0 and an item "B" at indent level 1, clicking the collapse toggle on "A" hides "B" from view.
Typing "Hello" in the text input of the first item and pressing Enter updates the item text to "Hello".
Reload keeps the outline structure: after adding an item "Test" and reloading, the tree still contains the item "Test".
